Subtracting the equations: 2p = 182 − 124 = 58, so p = 29 cents. Then e = 124 − 87 = 37, and check: 5(29) + 37 = 182 ✓.

Solution A gets 29, which is correct. (Its remark that E "is the same as the second equation" is loosely worded, but the answer is right.)

Solution B made an elimination error: multiplying by −5 gives −15p − 5e, which does not eliminate p when added to 5p + e. Its answer of 27 is wrong.

WINNER: A
